note: Expected outcomes the built engine must reach ON ITS OWN through general rules (never hard-coded in the engine; no place names in engine code). Checked by the build gate against each trip's plan and suggested picks.

live-hamburg-stay.why: Day trips need travelers' evidence (Wikivoyage day-trip listing, UNESCO, listed sights), not town fame (Hamburg dry run, Nov 18).

Day-trip towns are groups with their own sights, and food & drink experiences (tastings, famous cafés, specialty shops from Wikivoyage Eat/Drink/Buy and map wine bars/wineries/confectioners) are places in a 'food & drink' category (Richard, Nov 18: wine tasting in Lübeck's centre).

food-drink-category.rule: Food & drink experiences are places (step 1), from free sources only: Wikivoyage Eat/Drink/Buy listings; OpenStreetMap amenity=ice_cream, shop=confectionery/chocolate/wine/cheese/deli, craft=winery/brewery/distillery, amenity=bar|pub with wine or local drink tags; products marked local or regional (OSM 'local'/'regional' produce tags, Wikidata 'protected designation of origin'). Tag 'local-favorite' when a travelers' guide recommends it, 'local-produce' when it sells what's made in the region.
food-drink-category.source: Richard, Nov 18: wine tasting in Lübeck's centre, all the wine is local, great ice cream shops.
